steps.text: Bring a rope and a shovel.
Go east from Venore's south gate through the swamp to the small cave. Use your shovel to open the hole and go down.
steps.source: Make your way through the swamp to a small cave (Mapper Coords 129.31, 125.30, 7). You will need to go east from Venore's south gate. Use your Shovel to open a hole, and go down into it.

steps.text: Head east and go down (orcs, orc spearmen, snakes).
steps.source: Once in the cave, head directly east and go down a level.

steps.text: Snakes, orcs, orc spearmen and one orc shaman on this level.
steps.source: On this level you will find a large number of Snakes, Orcs, Orc Spearmen, and one Orc Shaman.

steps.text: The box in the south-east corner of the room: a magic light wand, an axe ring and a blank rune (the box isn't on the 7.1 map; this is its 7.6 spot).
steps.source: The quest box is in the south-east corner of the room.
